conception.note: The AI-literacy-plus-data-governance angle and the Karpathy 'compile, don't re-derive' framing were the author's; the model stress-tested scope and proposed term candidates against research gaps.

structure.note: The multi-lens entry schema, the category taxonomy and the README section order were settled across many rounds of back-and-forth, with neither side owning the result.

production.note: Every concept entry plus the README, glossary and changelog prose was model-generated from author-set specs and vetted source sets, reviewed batch by batch before each push.

curation.note: The model ran every revision pass; the author scored each candidate term for inclusion and made the cut, fold and discard calls without editing the text directly.

verification.note: The model checked sources and reconciled SRC-IDs against a maintained registry; the author set the sourcing standard, ruled on contested citations, and signs off before each publish.
